observations: Vain tammilankkuinen pöytäpinta: viillot ja kuluma, vahapisarat ja pienet vahatahrat sekä himmeä nokiläiskä. Ei kortteja, noppia, kynttilöitä tai pinnalla lepääviä esineitä.
Pinnan reunoilla on pieniä kiinteiden naulanpäiden kaltaisia tummia pisteitä puun rakenteessa; ne eivät ole irrallista pelirekvisiittaa. Root tarkistaa nämä itsenäisesti.
Vahapisaroissa on hieman paikallista mikrokohokuvan tummuutta. Ei voimakasta suuntavaloa tai vinjettiä; nokiläiskä on materiaalijälki.

assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: tileable game material base-color hemp sack surface texture.
Primary request: photorealistic perpendicular surface photograph of coarse grey-brown hemp sacking for a late-15th-century castle supply sack.
Composition: square 1024 by 1024 target, entirely flat hemp cloth fills every pixel with no sack silhouette, opening, folds or background. A single small simple faded dark abstract merchant mark near the center: a plain triangle inside a plain circle, with NO letters and NO numbers. One narrow straight hand-sewn horizontal construction seam crosses the fabric a little below center; natural coarse hemp stitches, modest wear.
Materials: rough matte grey-brown natural hemp yarn, evident coarse woven grid, slightly irregular strands and short fibers, worn faded hand-stamped pigment for the abstract mark.
Tiling: seamless periodic texture in BOTH X and Y; opposing edges match weave phase, material color and fiber scale. The seam continues across the left/right edges. The centered mark stays wholly inside the tile, away from the edges. No top or bottom hems, no vertical side seam, no cut fabric edges.
Lighting: perfectly even neutral diffuse illumination, no directional shadows, perspective, vignette, gradient, drape or gloss.
Constraints: newly invented original material from text only; no modern print, letters, numerals, words, logo, watermark, human or face, source-image pixels, museum object copy or extra objects.
